Answer: B
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates volume loss in the right hemithorax with a mediastinal shift towards the right, which is consistent with right-sided pulmonary hypoplasia. The "kinked" vessel sign (often representing an anomalous or displaced pulmonary vein) in the right cardiophrenic angle is a specific radiographic feature associated with this congenital anomaly.
